proposed_capability: MoonWake /sixth-gear P141: select bounded locally trained semantic variational autoencoder with decoder over existing evidence-verified 5x5x3 Sims spatial patch intake; user instances learn from consented gameplay on their own device; no central server, raw screens, upload, new computer controller, imagined geometry or game effects.
player_save_control_impact: No automatic game observer, Windows hooks, per-frame scan, telemetry, server/listener, save access or upload. Opt-in every explicit local training call; only structurally bounded semantic cells validated by the pre-existing spatial convolution's real route-event evidence. Install-owned user-scoped directory and atomic bounded JSON model with no raw names or pixels. No decoder output can create game passage or host input permit.
expected_outcome: An actual trainable encoder μ/logvar, reparameterized Gaussian latent vector and trainable sigmoid decoder using ELBO (reconstruction+KL); deterministic replay/holdout and baseline tracked; scope-isolated local training corpus and checkpoint with no network; status/advisory only. Preserve existing traversal and VOI owners, and keep BI-002 live gate active.
negative_tests: Training opt-in absent denies before IO
Invalid geometry, stale/cross-world/unknown player, unreviewed route outcome denies
Prior trained model remains unchanged on invalid/nonfinite/oversize data
No raw screenshot/Sim names/other user's data in checkpoint
Reconstruction never grants walk, viewport click or new graph edge
No runtime Sims or native EA source certification
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; no automatic model migration or game/save mutation; all user-scoped local training state remains under existing explicit uninstall retention controls, not removed by git rollback.
unresolved_unknowns: No real EA/Windows Sims Live Mode runtime or patch-specific spatial capture exposed through this connector
True value of VAE on real labels needs local dataset and measured independent holdout
No federated or network learning authorized; sharing models across users requires separate consent/security/aggregation work
decision_rationale: P141 tested four competing theses: centralized gameplay collection [REJECT: privacy and no provider], raw-frame video VAE [DEFER: sensor provenance absent/high privacy], dense reconstructed SLAM control [REJECT: hallucinated geometry violates verified passages], and local low-dimensional semantic patch VAE over existing reviewed event contract [SELECT: demonstrated bounded source and reversible validation]. P95 should inspect model/data storage owners; P82 must measure deterministic train vs holdout without promoting synthetic metrics to gameplay.
